name: AABB Voxel Intersection
definition: Checks if two voxel sprites intersect by computing the axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) overlap and iterating through all voxel coordinates within that overlap.
summary: AABB Voxel Intersection is a brute-force method that checks every voxel coordinate within an axis-aligned bounding box to detect collisions, differing from hierarchical approaches by iterating directly through integer grid positions.
